phrasings: Which drugs are used to treat {condition}?
What are the treatment options with drugs for {condition}?

metrics.reference_recall: share of the question's reference statements entailed by the answer (NLI judge of NB03, P(entail) ≥ 0.5; premise = answer)
metrics.reference_contradiction: share of reference statements contradicted by the answer (P(contradiction) ≥ 0.5): a hallucination proxy (K-QA style)
metrics.drug_naming: treatment questions only: the answer names ≥ 1 in-scope drug or drug class of the question's condition
metrics.non_answer: the answer says the passages do not answer the question
metrics.verified_support: test only, subset: share of the answer's claims that CliniVer (baseline v2) labels Supported / Contradicted

decision_rules.selection: on dev: highest mean reference_recall among variants whose reference_contradiction ≤ G0 + 0.02 AND whose drug_naming on the treatment questions ≥ G0's; ties within 0.01 → fewer LLM calls
decision_rules.adoption: the selected variant replaces G0 in the service if, on test, reference_recall − G0 > 0 (paired bootstrap point estimate, 95% CI reported), reference_contradiction ≤ G0 + 0.02, and drug_naming on the test treatment questions ≥ G0's

evaluation.dev: EXP-09-001 dev questions (G4 vs the cached G0 / G3 answers): sanity check only, no selection
evaluation.seen_test: EXP-09-001 test questions: SEEN (the error analysis read them), reported as seen; human-written reference statements

drug_questions: What are the common side effects of {drug}?
fresh_test.metrics: CliniVer verification of every answer (baseline v2): share of claims Supported / Contradicted; drug naming on the treatment questions; non-answers

round2.adoption: G4 replaces G0 in the service if ALL hold: (a) seen test: reference_contradiction ≤ G0 + 0.02 and reference_recall ≥ G0 − 0.01 (point estimates; CIs reported); (b) fresh test: verified Contradicted share ≤ G0 + 0.02 and verified Supported share ≥ G0 − 0.02; (c) drug naming on all treatment questions ≥ G0's

evaluation.seen: EXP-09-001 test questions and the EXP-09-002 fresh questions: SEEN; routed answers reuse the cached G0 / G3 answers

drug_questions: What are the serious risks of {drug}?
treatment_questions: What are the first-line drugs for {condition}?
fresh_test_2.metrics: CliniVer verification of every answer (G0 vs H1): share of claims Supported / Contradicted; drug naming; non-answers

round3.adoption: H1 replaces G0 in the service if ALL hold: (a) EXP-09-001 test: reference_contradiction ≤ G0 + 0.02 and reference_recall ≥ G0 − 0.01; (b) fresh_test_2: verified Contradicted share ≤ G0 + 0.02 and verified Supported share ≥ G0 − 0.02; (c) drug naming on all treatment questions ≥ G0's
